g.text: Title: Electrode inputs 1-4 - protected bench candidate

g.desc: Title: Electrode inputs 1-4 - protected bench candidate

g.text: CH1+ and CH1- each pass 2 x 47k, the TVS clamp, then 4.7k into the ADC; 220 pF C0G across the pair. JP1 selects bipolar (1-2) or the buffered shared REF, REF_BUF (2-3), for the negative leg.

g.desc: CH1+ and CH1- each pass 2 x 47k, the TVS clamp, then 4.7k into the ADC; 220 pF C0G across the pair. JP1 selects bipolar (1-2) or the buffered shared REF, REF_BUF (2-3), for the negative leg.

g.text: TPD2E2U06 leakage limit applies at 2.5 V. The ground clamp is not isolation. Fit one shunt per JP; change it with power off.

g.desc: TPD2E2U06 leakage limit applies at 2.5 V. The ground clamp is not isolation. Fit one shunt per JP; change it with power off.

g.text: JP pin 3 is REF_BUF, the buffered REF electrode; it passes through the same negative-leg network as a bipolar electrode. No extra capacitors from inputs to GND.

g.desc: JP pin 3 is REF_BUF, the buffered REF electrode; it passes through the same negative-leg network as a bipolar electrode. No extra capacitors from inputs to GND.
